full_judgment:
33. Every Criminal Trial is an odyssey of discovery in which truth is the quest. It is the duty of prosecution to explore every avenue open to it in order to unveil truth to advance cause of justice. Witness or witnesses who can throw sufficient light in unfolding truth are to be produced before witness box as witnesses by prosecution. Non-examination of material witnesses shall give rise to a strong presumption against prosecution case in respect of involvement of an accused in the felony allegedly committed by him. If a material witness who would unroll the genesis of incident is not examined, prosecution case can be termed as suffering from serious deficiency and infirmity and withholding of such a material and vital witness would oblige the Court to draw an adverse inference against the prosecution by holding that if the witness would have been examined he would not have supported the prosecution case as projected. 

 34. Prosecution case portrayed in first information report is that Swopan Kumar Biswas, Project Officer, Grameen Arthayan Kendra, having been posted with the information of snatching away of money from PW 16 Tahmina Khatoon, he along with Abdus Sabur Molla on a motorcycle hurried to the place of occurrence and village people started hounding convict-appellant Alam and Abdus Sabur Molla followed convict-appellant Zakir Hossain. Swopan Kumar Biswas effected a seizure on convict-appellant Alam and Abdus Sabur Molla caught hold of convict-appellant Zakir Hussain. Swopan Kumar Biswas and Abdus abur Molla were the most competent persons to unveil prosecution case but they have been withheld by prosecution without offering any explanation whatsoever for their non-production in Court as prosecution witnesses. Withholding of Swopan Kumar Biswas and Abdus Sabur Molla who had been very much important and vital witnesses in proof of criminality of convict-appellants was fatal to the edifice of prosecution case and a presumption against the trustworthiness of prosecution case in bridgment of convict-appellants in the felony arose.
